# 15 · Onboard autonomy

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

Putting a companion computer next to the flight controller, bridging MAVLink into ROS 2, commanding the aircraft from your own code, expressing a mission as a behaviour tree, and making the whole thing start itself and fail safely.

**6 lessons · ≈ 10 h 15 min** · [Course map](../COURSE_MAP.md) · [Dependency graph](../curriculum/dependency-graph.md)
